payload.reason: The evidence indicates that fine-tuning BERT on natural language inference datasets, specifically SNLI, improves the quality of embeddings, particularly for semantic similarity tasks.

claims.text: Fine-tuning BERT on natural language inference datasets improves the quality of sentence embeddings, especially for semantic similarity tasks.
Combining embeddings from different layers of BERT can further enhance performance on various tasks.
Fine-tuning on SNLI does not lead to significant improvements for QA datasets, indicating a domain mismatch.
